No intermediaries.

Madlyn offers this fabulous renovated 70 m2 commercial space for rent. The space has two main rooms. It is located on a busy street with good orientation.

Located on Juan Tornero Street, this location enjoys excellent amenities and accessibility, both by car and public transport.

If you are interested in seeing it, do not hesitate to contact us.
